features: Compatibility: The silicone ring cover is specially designed for oura smart ring users and is perfectly compatible with OURA RING Gen 4/OURA RING GEN 3 Heritage/Horizon. Note: Smart rings are not included.

Unique Design: Hexasider understands your convenience needs when using the Oura Ring, so we have designed precise notches on the protector. This unique design perfectly matches the dimple of the Oura ring, allowing you to quickly locate the charging position when wearing the ring without disassembling the casing. Charging is simple and convenient, greatly improving your usage efficiency.

High-quality Silicone: The elastic cover made of high-quality silicone is soft, comfortable and lightweight. There will be no additional burden when wearing it, and the protective case will not cause allergic reactions or discomfort to the fingers.

Three Sizes to Choose: Considering the different ring sizes for various users, Hexasider silicone rings are available in three sizes: S, M, and L. The S size is suitable for ring sizes of 4/5/6/7, the M size is suitable for ring sizes of 8/9/10/11, and the L size is suitable for ring sizes of 12/13/14/15. Ensure that most ring sizes fit perfectly, allowing everyone to find the most suitable ring set for themselves.

Perfect Protection & Fashionable : The ring case can provide protection during housework, work, training, sports, etc., minimizing scratches and wear on the ring to the greatest extent. It offers 12 different colors. You can freely match them according to your clothing and outfits, adding a touch of fashion sense to you.
